# Le'Jeune Land Management, LLC

> Locally owned, owner-operated landscaping, lawn care, land clearing and outdoor construction company based in Cedar Creek, Texas, serving Bastrop County. Residential and commercial. Free estimates. Also written as Le Jeune, LeJeune or Lejeune Land Management (LJLM).

- Website: https://ljlmservices.com/
- Phone: (512) 575-5452
- Email: ljlmservices@gmail.com
- Owner: David Young
- Based in: Cedar Creek, Texas 78612
- Motto: "When Excellence Matters."

## Services

- Lawn and property maintenance: scheduled weekly or bi-weekly mowing, edging and blowing
- Lawn improvements: sod installation, reseeding, fertilization and aeration
- Tree trimming and stump grinding
- Pressure washing: sidewalks, driveways, parking areas, brick and stone walls
- Seasonal property refresh: bed cleanup, fresh mulch, seasonal prep
- Land and property clearing: underbrush, overgrowth and unwanted trees
- Fence design and construction: privacy (wood or metal), chain link and ranch rail; new builds, replacements and repairs
- Deck design and construction, including pergolas and gazebos
- Landscape design and construction
- Raised-bed garden design and construction
- Urban and country homestead design and implementation

## Service area

Bastrop County, Texas and surrounding communities: Cedar Creek, Bastrop, Elgin, Smithville, Paige, Red Rock, Rosanky, McDade, Wyldwood, Dale, Del Valle and Mustang Ridge.

## Common questions

- Estimates are free. Call or text (512) 575-5452.
- Both one-time jobs (fences, decks, cleanups) and recurring maintenance are available.
- Both residential and commercial properties are served.
